headline: MEDICARE CUTOFF
dek: Social Security letters tell an estimated 300,000 legal immigrants their Medicare will end, The Washington Post reported.

nodes.text: Tax and spending law (H.R. 1) limits Medicare to citizens, green-card holders, Cuban-Haitian entrants and COFA migrants.
Social Security starts mailing letters to enrollees who no longer qualify or must confirm their status.
CMS mails a follow-up letter on pink paper.
Coverage ends for those who can't confirm an eligible status.

means.label: Who is affected:
means.text: Refugees, asylum grantees, TPS holders and trafficking victims who met work rules, per the Post.

means.label: The administration:
means.text: CMS says the changes affect “a limited number of people with Medicare.”

means.label: The criticism:
means.text: Advocates warn patients on dialysis could lose coverage for treatment.

sources: Sources: The Washington Post, Nov. 24; CMS noncitizen eligibility job aid; The Herald Business, Nov. 25.
